mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 2.0% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls below 2.0% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If GDPC1 remains below 2.0% for 2 months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.
